system.description: All it takes is a single strike to shatter an enemies balance, knocking them off guard, as they find it difficult to even stand up straight. When you use this technique, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are Balance Broken. Once you use this Martial Technique you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

activities.label: Balance Breaker
activities.text: On an unarmed or Taijutsu hit that deals unarmed damage. Not again until the end of your next turn.

activities.label: Balance Broken

rules.text: Can't gain AC or DR bonuses from jutsu. Willingly moving more than 5 ft or casting a Mobility (M) jutsu costs its Reaction, or it falls Prone and can't stand until the start of its next turn.

activities.text: On a failed save; ends at the end of its turn (from 6th level, Perfected Stillness: a save at the end of each of its turns ends it).

rules.text: Balance Broken (defined in Extra Attack): disadvantage on Strength saves is on the effect; the rest is at the table.
